say:1:1331113201:1.source_cn: 是的，我们向艾雅女神祈祷。

say:2:1331113202:1.text: If she bestows her divine power on the deceased, they will be able to find eternal peace in her realm.
say:2:1331113202:1.source_cn: 如果祂降下神力，那么死者将能升入女神的国度，得享永生安乐。
say:2:1331113202:1.male: If she bestows her divine power on the deceased, they will be able to find eternal peace in her realm.
say:2:1331113202:1.female: If she bestows her divine power on the deceased, they will be able to find eternal peace in her realm.
